annotations.title: Rewrite up to 15 texts with one instruction

description: Rewrite up to 15 texts with one instruction — Apply one rewrite instruction to up to 15 texts at once (product blurbs, emails, notifications, support macros, ad lines). texts = items separated by | or newlines, or a JSON array (each up to 1,500 chars); instruction = what to change. Optional tone and max_words. Offline checks on every result: numbers and links from the original must survive, word-count change, over-length and unchanged warnings. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

instruction.description: e.g. make it friendlier and more helpful

texts.description: e.g. Your order shipped. Tracking will be sent later.|We cannot refund after 30 days.

name: ai_rewrite_batch
